items: 【Trellis for Climbing Plants Outdoor 6.2ft】1 pack, 6.2ft(74.4 in) Tall x 12in Wide obelisk trellis for climbing plants. You can adjust the desired height based on the growth of the plant. Provide ample space for your climbing plants and vines to support the plants well to grow upright and healthy

【Easy to Install】No screws, no wrench or screwdriver needed. Just rotate to the correct angle and position to assemble the plant support trellis from bottom to top. NOTE: Pre-drill holes in the ground to help push the garden obelisk trellis into the ground. To enhance sturdiness, the garden trellis can be inserted into the soil for a longer length

【Rust-proof & Weather-resistant Metal Trellis】 Metal obelisk trellis poles cover a heavy-duty PE plastic coat, contains UV inhibitors to resist sun damage. Protect your climbing plants from hot or inclement weather. The support circle is made of high-quality plastic, which is sturdy and friendly for plants. The rose trellis is durable yet lightweight, directly going into the ground or pot for the best durability and stability indoors and outdoors, and holds up in high wind or heavy rain

【Elegant Design】With a matte black finish, the rose trellis can easily blend into its natural surroundings. Let your garden roses and vegetables climb the trellis and be the focal point of your garden. Can also be used to decorate indoor trellis with potted plants at home. We provide 2 additional top decorations, you can choose the decoration you like.

【Decorative & Multi-purpose】This vertical tomato tower garden obelisk trellis provide superior strength and sturdy support to climb for flowering vines, vegetables and other plants. Such as roses, clematis, ivy, morning glory, tomato, pea, cucumber, blackberry, house plant etc. Garden trellises not only guide the growth of plants but also clears up messy gardens. This obelisk trellis must be an eye-catcher in any patio, lawn, garden, yard, terrace or living room when placed

【Widely Application】Can help the growth of roses, clematis, ivy, jasmine, morning glory, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, blackberries, beans, grapevines, long stems, fruit vines, houseplants, etc. The ergonomic design ensures that your plant's fruits and leaves do not weigh down the stem. TIP: Suitable for light and small plants, not recommended for overly large and heavy plants

【Core Load-bearing Parameters】This product is specially designed for home gardening plants with a regular load-bearing capacity ≤ 15kg (suitable for the growth needs of most vine plants), which can stably support the vine climbing and foliage growth of small and medium-sized vine plants such as ivy, pothos, morning glory, rose, jasmine, wisteria, etc.

【Notes】1. Hanging heavy objects (such as flower pots, tools, etc.) is prohibited to avoid bracket deformation and loosening caused by exceeding the load-bearing range; 2. When the vines grow too densely, it is recommended to properly prune the branches and leaves to distribute the weight and prevent excessive local stress; 3. When used outdoors, in case of severe weather such as heavy rain and strong wind, the bottom of the bracket can be temporarily reinforced to avoid tilting caused
